summary: Natuzzi S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing fourth-quarter 2025 financial results and a strategic restructuring. The company reported a EUR 15.5 million quarterly loss, a EUR 7.1 million asset sale in January 2026, and initiated due diligence with a potential Italian institutional investor for capital strengthening. The Board authorized an out-of-court negotiated composition proceeding (Composizione Negoziata della Crisi), a voluntary Italian restructuring framework with limited court involvement, expected to be filed in coming weeks. Management retains ordinary powers during the process. Watch for stakeholder negotiations and the formal filing under the Italian framework.
